Alex — bumping this in case it dropped during the sprint. Quick answers inline below to help procurement and finance get unblocked: 

1) SOC 2 / data retention:
- Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II; we can provide the attestation and our security pack (network diagrams, encryption at-rest/in-transit, KMS options).
- Data retention for inference request logs is configurable per-customer (default 30 days for hosted); Dedicated/private options allow longer retention with custom retention policies and audit logging.
Link to security pack: https://redwood.com/security/oxbridge-packet (PDF)

2) Ballpark pricing (pilot):
- Hosted API: ~$0.006–0.012 per token (depends on model family and token mix); good for fast evaluation without infra overhead.
- Dedicated (small reserved pool): monthly commit starting around $15k–$25k depending on GPU type and slots; good if you need predictable throughput and isolation.
I can run a short estimate for your 10k-req/day profile and share a one-pager.

If it helps we also offer a 10-minute office-hours slot with an engineer to go over integration concerns — you can book here: https://calendly.com/redwood-qa/10min

Happy to provide the SOC2 PDF and a short cost playbook — tell me where to drop them and I’ll get them over today.

Best,
